explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 63 named tracks, EPs, reissues and catalogue cuts across Juno's current techno release list, Resident Advisor's current review index, official label pages for Mind Medizin, Butter Sessions and Renegade Methodz, and overlooked 1995/2008 catalogue reissues. Official and attributed written evidence only; no audio audition.
exclusions: Run 185's Oscar Later, Excalibur/DJ Spence and Shin Watanabe field and Runs 170–184 were not recycled; canonical identities, active placement-specific rejects, untriggered PARKED revisits, prior unresolved identities and exact utility-ledger identities were excluded.

The fresh field included current releases, adjacent/emerging artists and labels, and overlooked catalogue material; nine leads survived because attributed exact-track or tightly scoped release descriptions supported a credible selection-lens hypothesis and at least one lawful current boundary.

Other inspected items were excluded for canonical or persistent-state duplication, generic tags, prestige, straight-function description without a serious form hypothesis, ambiguous naming, future-only availability or lack of a credible placement hypothesis.
All placement pairs were re-derived from the current 50-track ledger and checked for adjacency and prose agreement. The protected Transparency → When We Froze → Stardancer sequence is untouched.
No Spotify connector, raw audio, audio-feature inference or invented identity was used.
